questions.question: Pre-delivery cleanup decisions — each is independent. Which to apply?

options.label: Remove demos/poc-narrated/ (Recommended)
options.description: Drop the original POC scaffold. narrate/ supersedes it and the Wikipedia YAML smoke-tests the same flow. Saves 235 LOC of dead code.

options.label: Add demos/.gitignore for out/
options.description: So generated media artifacts (mp4/wav/webm/aiff) never get committed. Keeps the demo YAML versioned while the rendered output stays local.

options.label: File a retro tracking ticket on board #2
options.description: Open an issue on the Remote Control board to record this work for history. Small thread, so genuinely optional.

options.label: READY TO CLOSE — proceed to Phase 5 (Recommended)
options.description: Apply cleanups above, single commit, merge --no-ff into main, push, switch worktree back to its bridge branch (don't remove). FF follow-up already filed.

options.label: NOT READY — something still to do
options.description: You want to address something before merge.

options.label: HAND OFF instead of close
options.description: Leave the worktree intact and write a handoff brief for a fresh session to pick up later (e.g. if you want to do FF integration in this same branch).
